name: Oshimai no Kyoudai
source:
Zakuro, the sister who hides nothing of her romantic feelings for her brother, and Kagini, her older brother who tries to distance himself from her to become "just ordinary siblings".

Spring break arrives for these two siblings, alone without family. As their forbidden love unfolds, what fate awaits Zakuro and Kagini...?

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/12683]Novelgame[/url]]
translation:
毫不掩饰对哥哥的浪漫感情的妹妹扎九郎，以及试图与她保持距离、成为“普通兄弟姐妹”的哥哥卡吉尼。

春假到来，两兄妹孤身一人，没有家人。随着禁忌之恋的展开，扎九郎和卡吉尼的命运又将如何……？

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/12683]Novelgame[/url]]
